note: East region is over-forecast by about 6% in the test period (limit 5%). Monitor after retraining; if it persists, East stores would receive slightly too much stock.
Express stores have higher error (38%) than Flagship stores (27%). This is day-to-day noise in small stores, not a systematic lean (bias -0.7%).
Single huge orders (for example Rs 16 lakh at S002 on 2025-10-14) cannot be forecast. They are caught by the anomaly workflow instead (Step 7).
The model uses no personal or customer data, only store and calendar information, so fairness is checked across stores, store types and regions.
SHAP values are computed with LightGBM's built-in TreeSHAP (pred_contrib=True); the contributions add up exactly to each prediction.
All findings come from synthetic data and must be re-checked on real data.
